messages:
sam_sales: Sharing the pen-test + vuln-scan bundle for Acme due diligence. Uploaded to s3://redwood-pt-deliverables/acme/2005-05-01-evidence.zip (internal). Checksums attached below. Question: customer asked for outbound IPs / egress policy for Private deployment — can we provide a concise list? Also they want remediation ETA per severity. Proposed cadence for sales pitch: 30/60/90 days but security might want a tighter timeline. /cc @maria_sec :eyes:

ash_eng: Confirming the bundle includes full scan XML exports, proof-of-concept snippets (redacted in public bundle), and triage notes. Pasted sha256 for the zip here: `sha256: 3f7b1e9a2c4d5f6a7b8c9d0e1f2a3b4c5d6e7f8a9b0c1d2e3f4a5b6c7d8e9f0a`. On egress: Hosted has published ranges; Dedicated/Private usually route through customer NAT — we can provide our recommended ports and CIDR ranges but fixed egress IPs require infra allocation.

maria_sec: For customer-facing remediation SLAs we typically advise: initial triage within 3 business days; Critical: mitigation or hotfix within 7-14 days; High: 30 days; Medium: 90 days. For sales collateral a simplified 14/30/90 is fine but flag that extremely high-impact issues may need faster action. We can redact PoCs if legal requests it. I'll draft an official remediation timeline doc. :thumbsup:

jordan_sre: For Hosted IP ranges see internal doc https://status.redwood.ai/ip-ranges (note: internal link). If customer requires static egress for Dedicated, we can allocate elastic NAT IPs — needs ticket to infra (INC-2244). Also confirming we do NOT egress logs containing customer PII; telemetry is scrubbed.

sam_sales: Great — can someone upload checksums + the remediation timeline into the same S3 folder and drop me a presigned link (7d expiry) I can hand to Acme security? They asked for a tar + sha256 or direct S3 export.

ash_eng: Uploaded checksums at s3://redwood-pt-deliverables/acme/checksums.txt and added README with remediation owner matrix. Presigned link (7d): https://s3.redwood.ai/presigned/ACME-evidence-200505?sig=EXAMPLE

maria_sec: I added remediation-timeline.md to the folder. It includes owner, target dates per severity, rollback steps, and a risk acceptance template. If Acme wants, we can also produce an executive summary (no PoCs) for legal reviewers.

deploy-bot: [artifact] acme-evidence-2005-05-01.zip uploaded by ash_eng — sha256: 3f7b1e9a2c4d5f6a7b8c9d0e1f2a3b4c5d6e7f8a9b0c1d2e3f4a5b6c7d8e9f0a

sam_sales: Perfect. I'll send the bundle + presigned link to Acme sec today and propose a 30m walkthrough next week to go over critical findings. If they push on SLA wording, I'll suggest 'initial triage within 3 business days; critical mitigation within 14 calendar days; high within 30; medium within 90' — @maria_sec, confirm final phrasing?

maria_sec: Confirmed. Use exact phrasing: "Initial triage within 3 business days; critical issues will have mitigation or compensating controls implemented within 14 calendar days; high within 30 calendar days; medium within 90 calendar days. Executive summary and PoC redaction available on request." Also note: any customer-requested retest should be scheduled via the support portal so we can track scope and timeline.

sam_sales: Thanks — handing off to customer outreach. I'll post any reply in this thread and escalate blockers. :pray:
